test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the following sentences in correct order to make a meaningful sentence

P: is urgently needed

Q: to prevent the misuse of user data

R: a comprehensive framework

S: for digital privacy laws
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2)** i.e. **RSPQ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the primary subject **"A comprehensive framework,"** which is indicated by **part (R).**
 
• Following the subject, the prepositional phrase **"for digital privacy laws" (S)** is needed to specify what the framework is intended for, creating the complete subject phrase **(RS).**
 
• **The next part,** **"is urgently needed" (P),** provides the main verb and predicate, establishing the necessity of the framework.
 
• **Ending with** the infinitive phrase **"to prevent the misuse of user data" (Q)** provides the logical purpose or reason behind the urgency, completing the thought.

Therefore, the correct sequence is **RSPQ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (PRSQ):** Starts with the verb "is urgently needed," which leaves the sentence without a proper introductory subject in this context.
 
• **Option 3 (RPQS):** While "A comprehensive framework is urgently needed" is grammatically okay, placing "to prevent the misuse of user data" before "for digital privacy laws" creates a confusing link between "user data" and "laws."
 
• **Option 4 (QSRP):** This sequence results in "To prevent the misuse of user data for digital privacy laws a comprehensive framework is urgently needed," which incorrectly implies the data belongs to the laws rather than the users.
